newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy '97 GDP seen slightly above 1.0 pct -Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Italy '97 GDP seen slightly above 1.0 pct -Fazio.

text.p: Italian economic activity is "unsatisfactory" and the economic slowdown already under way in 1996 worsened at the end of the year, Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said.
Fazio said on the basis of evaluations currently available "growth of gross domestic product (GDP) will be a little more than one percent in 1997."
"At the economic level, the level of economic activity remains unsatisfactory," he said in a speech to an Italian foreign exchange convention.
Fazio's one percent forecast is slightly higher than a Bank of Italy forecast at the end of October.
The government has an official target of 2.0 percent growth for 1997 but Labour Minister Tiziano Treu said recently it was more likely to be 1.2 to 1.5 percent.
